purpose: Re-run the ten prespecified method families under one expanding-window origin protocol from the original evaluation start through the latest released China CPI target month.

targets.series: official national CPI year-on-year first release
targets.origin_rule: origin reference month = target reference month minus horizon

origin_clock.rule: official first-release timestamp of the origin-month CPI plus one minute
origin_clock.input_availability_rule: source availability timestamp must be strictly earlier than the origin timestamp
origin_clock.target_release_rule: target first-release timestamp must be strictly later than the origin timestamp
origin_clock.model_specific_eligibility: Each method uses its frozen input requirements; native coverage and the all-method common-origin intersection are reported separately.

statistical_models.refit_rule: At every outer origin, estimate from the expanding sequence of first-release CPI observations strictly available before that origin.
statistical_models.ar1: OLS with intercept on consecutive monthly first-release YoY pairs; recursively forecast to each requested horizon.
statistical_models.failed_fit_policy: Retain failed or missing predictions and report their origin; do not substitute another model or retry with altered settings.

learned_heads.fit_rule: Refit at every eligible outer origin using only historical as-of inputs from their own origin and labels whose official first-release time is strictly earlier than the outer-origin time.
learned_heads.inner_validation: 12 most recent eligible historical origins with an h=3 label released before the outer origin
learned_heads.final_fit: Fresh same-seed initialization on all eligible pre-origin rows, all four registered horizons, for the selected epoch count
learned_heads.architecture_optimizer_and_stopping: Use the pinned G1/G4 implementation without hyperparameter search.
learned_heads.failed_fit_policy: Retain failure and missing coverage; no fallback, retry, or post-result substitution.

point_in_time_inputs.historical_context: Use the first-release CPI context available at each origin; use the archived, origin-specific G3 inputs for origins 2025-01 through 2026-08.
point_in_time_inputs.mask_semantics: True means unavailable or unresolved and is supplied as an explicit mask; no interpolation or carry-forward substitution.
point_in_time_inputs.2026_09_target: The target release timestamp may be used for key validation, but its numeric first-release value is excluded from forecast construction and can be opened only by the separate scoring stage.
point_in_time_inputs.training_labels: Earlier evaluation-period labels may enter a later origin's expanding training set only after their first release and only under the strict origin cutoff.

scoring.seed_aggregation: Average seed-specific absolute errors within each origin, then average across origins.
scoring.missing_prediction_rule: Do not treat missing forecasts as zero error; retain planned calendar coverage and report the actual MAE and paired-comparison denominators separately.

interpretation.scope: One Chinese CPI case; no general model ranking or independent prospective validation is established by this run.
